distinct_from.why: The answering and calibrating themselves, moved from the copy gate; this file only reads the person's rows through the door and hands them to it.
The one settings reader, imported here, not copied.
Reads a branch's check rows to judge a unit; it lists the questions and never answers them. This reads ask rows by id and labelled-line rows by set to answer and calibrate.

Index rows only: this tool's own owner row ("answer copy-rule asks with a person's local models") and the where-a-person-stands row whose evidence names labelled-line rulings; neither is code that answers asks.

A sibling that WRITES labelled-line rulings (record:check:ruling-<hex>) to the person's list:checks; this tool only reads those rows as calibration examples and answers asks with a model. Writing the rows is not answering asks, so it is not an owner of this job.
The generated tool catalog: one flat row per tool copied from this folder's tool-rows.json (publish-tool-catalog.mjs); it lists the tool and runs nothing.
